title: Home Hardening Basics
description: Covers reinforcing doors and entry points, locating and labeling utility shutoffs, and hardening for hurricanes, tornadoes, earthquakes, wildfire, and floods. Includes layered deterrence, detection, and delay security, safe room basics, backup power, low-cost quick wins, and an annual checklist.
shortDescription: Secure entry points, know utility shutoffs, and prep for local hazards
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
